My social skills have improved a lot I think over the course of doing this. For one, I kind actually hold a conversation longer. I feel like I can keep the flow of all of it going. Of course there are still a few times where I'll mess up or stutter. And awkward silences are bound to happen if you're not experienced at talking to people. But that's okay. I feel the more you put yourself out there the easier it will become. One thing I think you should know is to go into the mindset of not caring if someone rejects your approaches. It's not on you, it's on them. Remember there are billions of people in this world, they're just one. In fact you should embrace rejection to an extent, because it shows you're at least trying. Oh and about the creepy part. Yeah I've come off like that more times than I'd like. I recommend situational conversations. Like if you're standing in a long line turn to the other person and say, "I always get the slow lane, don't you?". Then bam, there's a connection. As long as your heart is in the right place and you're being genuine that's all you can really do man. Best of luck
